policy_title: Pacific Data Commons — Transaction Volume Integrity Policy

volume_sources.label: Institutional pilot providers
volume_sources.description: Samoan and Pacific government agencies and research institutions publishing real operational data. Buyers are independent agents and researchers transacting for genuine research or commercial purposes.

volume_sources.label: Independent agent developers (design partners)
volume_sources.description: Third-party developers building Pacific-relevant tools against PDC endpoints. Where a small USDC onboarding grant has been provided, this is disclosed in writing to both the partner and competition organisers. Partners transact from their own independent wallets at their own discretion.
volume_sources.disclosure_note: Any grants provided to design partners are listed in the competition submission appendix.

volume_sources.label: Operational canary transactions
volume_sources.description: Hourly self-funded uptime monitoring queries run from the SBP Agent wallet against SBP-managed pilot endpoints to confirm continuous liveness during the October measurement window.
volume_sources.labelling_method: Off-chain structured logging. The x402 client SDK (pinned version) does not expose a caller-supplied note or extra field on outgoing AVM transactions — this is a known SDK limitation documented in packages/pdc-x402-adapter/src/index.ts. Canary tx IDs are logged per cycle in sbp-agent structured logs and surfaced via the /health API for cross-reference against on-chain records.
volume_sources.on_chain_labelling_status: Deferred post-competition pending upstream SDK support. See adapter TODO comment.

exclusions.wash_trading: SBP does not generate artificial query volume against PDC endpoints from SBP-controlled wallets for the purpose of inflating leaderboard position.
exclusions.self_dealing: The SBP PayTo wallet (LN745UCDQNFIBDY6JFW7FNK333MADQZQVQFMCVR3GXXUTB52O2NYPZN3YY) receives fees only — it does not initiate queries. No SBP wallet acts as both payer and payee on the same endpoint.
exclusions.synthetic_buyers: All non-canary buyer wallets are independent of SBP. SBP does not control buyer wallets or instruct buyers on query behaviour.

verification.canary_tx_cross_reference: Call GET /health on the directory API. The response includes the canary.wallet address and canary.enabled flag. Cross-reference tx IDs in sbp-agent Railway logs against on-chain records at https://algoexplorer.io or https://explorer.perawallet.app.
verification.organiser_contact: SBP will provide full log exports to competition organisers on request. Canary volume will be excluded from claimed volume figures if organisers determine it should not count — written confirmation sought from organisers before October window.
